A useful little guide

How to use typing speed & accuracy

Measure typing speed and character accuracy against a visible passage. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

  1. Choose a study tool and review its input labels.
  2. Enter your scores, course details, passage or available study time.
  3. Run the tool and review the result and its assumptions.

A detail to keep in mind

Questions, answered.

Is typing speed & accuracy free to use?

Yes. This tool is part of Nepocore’s free browser toolkit. There is no paid tier, file-download gate or application account required.

What should I check before using the result?

Results depend on passage, keyboard and timing. This is a practice measurement, not a standardized hiring assessment.

Does this tool upload my files or text?

The tool processes its input in your browser. File contents and text are not sent to a processing server. See the privacy page for local storage and hosting details.
